correctness.rationale: Explicit Gram row solves all recurrence and boundary equations; positivity and strictly decreasing differences follow from closed form. Stieltjes positive-measure step reduction is exact for every bounded monotone input. First-cell critical point produces -delta; later-cell alternating estimates (plus separate n=1,2 checks) exclude larger excursions; reflection handles right endpoint. r iteration proves strict monotonic convergence. Exact-rational checker verified all candidate extrema for n<=120; symbolic inequalities were separately verified.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The kernel and tridiagonal recurrence are standard equivalences, but the admissible extremizers differ: unrestricted sign masks can oscillate in each cell whereas monotone inputs reduce to a single step. value.rationale: L2 spline least-squares projection is standard and does not preserve range even for monotone measurements. A sharp boundary safety constant for every equal mesh, explicit single-step extremizers and strict algebraic infinite-grid limit solve a naturally motivated shape-constrained stability question, not a sampled numerical curiosity.
